title: WPSS/1998/2013 of Ramendra Singh Bisht Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1998 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
 Mr. B.S. Adhikari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Addl. C.S.C. for the
State.
Since facts of the present case are not
disputed, therefore, present case is taken up
for hearing today itself with the consent of
the learned counsel for the parties and is
being disposed of.
Petitioner was working as Assistant
Teacher with Government Higher
Secondary School Khalsi, Uttarkashi.
Pursuant to the advertisement dated
03.05.2010, annexure No. 3, petitioner
applied to work with Shyama Prasad
Mukherji Abhinav School. Petitioner was
selected and was posted with Shyama
Prasad Mukherji Abhinav School (Navodai
School) Uttarkashi as Assistant Teacher
L.T. (Science) vide order dated 01.07.2010,
annexure No. 4 to the writ petition. Vide
order dated 15.01.2011, annexure No. 7 to
the writ petition, petitioner and other
teachers working with Navodai Schools
were absorbed temporary for the period till
regularly appointed incumbent joins on the
post. Additional Director vide order dated
22nd January, 2013, annexure No. 8 to the
writ petition, issued direction that till
further orders, none of the teachers working
with Navodai School should be disturbed.
Even Director Education vide order dated
10th October, 2013, annexure No. 10 to the
writ petition, also directed not to disturb the

teachers working with the Navodai School.
Vide impugned order dated 11.12.2013,
Principal/respondent No. 5 on the oral
direction of Chief Education Officer,
relieved the petitioner to give his joining in
his original Government School where he
was originally working.
Impugned order dated 11.12.2013
seems to have been passed on the oral
direction of Chief Education Officer which
itself is in violation of the direction issued
time to time by the Additional Director and
Director Education not to disturb teachers
working with Navodai School till further
orders.
I find force in the argument of the
learned counsel for the petitioner that till no
regularly appointed incumbent joins in
place of petitioner, petitioner should not be
relieved.
Consequently, writ petition is
allowed. Impugned order is quashed. If
petitioner has already been relieved, he
shall be given re-joining immediately at
Rajeev Gandhi Navodia School and shall
be allowed to work till appropriate decision
in this regard is taken by the Director of
School Education or till new incumbent
joins as the case may be.
CLMA No. 13988 of 2013 also
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 19.12.2013
Shiv
